title: Current astronauts with their own experiences

tellings.quote: I've spoke to current astronauts that have had their own instances.

plain: Some astronauts still serving today have had their own sightings of unexplained objects, according to Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot. Graves tells Michels he has 'spoke to current astronauts that have had their own instances', though he gives no names and no details of what they saw.
